notes.title: Demo Patch
notes.content: [p]We are flabbergasted by the response to the trailer and demo for our tiny, quirky game experiment. It started as a small Godot experiment and became a real game people actually play. Crazy![/p][p]As we don't approach it as a usual "commercial" game where you think a lot about target audience, how to reach people, etc we were surprised it resonates so well with you people out there. [/p][p]Most of our decisions around the game and what we want to do is based around if we find it fun or a good learning experience and for someone like me, who made games for a living for more than 25 years this is a liberating, fun experience. [/p][p]Thanks to all the feedback we got through the in-game reporting tool we addressed some things in an update:[/p][list][*][p]Vsync is now really on or the game is limited to 144 frames max[/p][/*][*][p]we added "sheep" as a language (a good example of a silly idea, but also a proof we can translate the game  very well. We are now looking for help to translate it in as many languages as we can)[/p][/*][*][p]changed the map "Misplaced" a bit and added one more solar energy. While we like that you like the difficulty of the game, we thought this is a tiny bit too much for the first real map)[/p][/*][*][p]adding "Best Turns" to the maps[/p][list][*][p]Can be turned of in options if this stresses you out[/p][/*][*][p]Shows your turns while playing[/p][/*][*][p]Saves your best round (the lesser turns you need, the better)[/p][/*][*][p]Shows you a badge when you beat your own turns[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Main menu  works on 16:10 now and doesnt have grey bars anymore[/p][/*][*][p]A lot smaller fixes I forgot to write down (sorry)[/p][/*][/list][p]Please keep reaching out with feedback, ideas and thoughts. I'm reading all of your lovely comments every morning and it's making my day! A lot cool suggestions and input. [/p][p][/p][p]Mäh Bah! [/p]

notes.title: Match Tree: Polaris
notes.content:
[h1]Event[/h1]
We exhibit Match Tree for the first time. At the Polaris in Hamburg from 11.-13.10.2024

[h1]About Match Tree[/h1]
Match Tree is a breathtaking puzzle experience (...it's actually a match 3 game).
Embark on an epic journey with pixie, gnome and witch full of adventure, mystery (huh?) and sheep.
Become the master of combination and create magnificent mansions from trees, flowers and carrots (I swear, it's fun!).

[h1]Dev insight[/h1]
Andreas talks about the origins of the game, godot, shows the editor and talks about the development so far.
